fields.statement: At 24073c15a, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestDaemonAutoUpdate -v passes, including the new TestDaemonAutoUpdateRelease: with rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate=release and a fake httptest release feed, a daemon on v0.1.0 installs the v0.2.0 release over its executable (via daemon.ChannelUpdate on release.ChannelRelease, no git or make), an up-to-date v0.2.0 is left alone, an incremental build v0.2.0-5-gabc1234 is not replaced by the release, and the latest feed is never fetched (the fake fails the test if it is). internal/daemon and internal/release tests pass. The diff wires the release value in runDaemon to release.ChannelRelease, accepts release in the setting's validation, and updates docs/reference/config.md and docs/runs-and-daemon.md. Note: the test sits in internal/api (daemon auto-update tests), not internal/daemon, where the existing latest-channel tests also live. make self-check only fails on stale .rhiza/rendered actor files from this run, fixed by rhiza render at close-out.
